title: fix(ui): restore held history when Stop advances the leaf
body:
Fixes a follow-up to the long-turn Stop history repair: an opening prompt can disappear behind **Show earlier** when the pane previously read a complete server prefix and Stop advances the active transcript leaf.

The older-page decision treated the previous row count as proof that the pane could reuse that prefix. The branch-identity guard correctly rejects held rows from a different leaf, so the two decisions could publish only the bounded tail. Remove the count shortcut and fetch the existing, bounded authoritative older page before publishing the replacement. Session/request ownership, branch isolation, window-reset behavior, the 1,000-row bound, and the retryable failure boundary remain unchanged.

This deliberately accepts one extra bounded history read for an already-held prefix after a cursor reset. There is no new cache, state mirror, protocol, retry, or startup import. This is a correctness repair, with no latency-win claim.

| Proof | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New advanced-leaf/held-prefix regression on base `f9b9af087c59c36c0e70e6d50ab67fa0f415fb5e` | Fails: authoritative older read skipped |
| Complete changed `chat-history.test.ts` | 25 passed, including branch isolation, large-gap, and read-failure controls |
| Original real-Gateway long-turn Stop E2E | 1 passed; opening prompt remains visible and no earlier-history boundary appears |
| `pnpm tsgo:ui` | Passed with the default typechecker |
| Production Knip | Passed (`pnpm deadcode:knip`) |
| Exact test-line ratchet | Passed after integrating #188620: 6,307,474 lines; ceiling 6,307,474; exact 25-line allocation |
| Independent review | Codex scoped-clean, P0–P2; repeated on the integrated candidate with complete changed files and coupled owners |

The E2E uses an isolated real Gateway, 48 real exec steps, a synthetic local model server, and headless Chromium. It builds matching production UI assets. The build reported 88,755 B startup JS gzip and one 33,559 B CSS request; it also reported the existing total raw CSS warning (1,560.4 KiB versus 1,560.2 KiB). This patch changes no CSS and makes no startup-byte comparison claim. The latest scheduled main also passed the original Stop E2E, so the intermittent PR failure is not classified as inherited; the added deterministic regression captures the missed owner decision directly.

The simplification removes the count-based coverage assumption from the existing reader. Production LOC: **88 → 86 (−2)**; test LOC: **602 → 627 (+25)**; allocation metadata: **+2**. No rendering or Solid ownership mechanisms are added; effect, listener, query, flush, and owner-API counts remain zero in the changed production file. Reports remain outside the repository.

Related original repair: `aef29790c63466236103d1ae4886bbd438f3a810`. Thanks to @vyctorbrzezowski for the original repair.

The first CI run (`41112759431`) had the old test-line ceiling debt and a pre-test bundled-root-help setup timeout. Current main `c0c068e1ecd9ec78a75ad6847e032f4d0f5b1241` was merged normally to include #188620 and the landed CSS correction #188587. The Stop implementation and coupled owners/tests are byte-identical to the locally proven head.

Current-head CI [41114831767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41114831767) passed the original Stop scenario in 26.156 s and the test-line ratchet. Its three remaining failures have the same exact test names and assertions on the latest completed scheduled-main run [41107007551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41107007551), head `9e8a058de8afcdaf03f5774979e7d2e494b80a1c`:

| Remaining CI failure | Matching main evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Quiet automation: keeps checks quiet while preserving meaningful status, freshness, visible results and run evidence | `updatedAt` equality at line 462 fails on both |
| Boot composer: keeps an unsent draft, its focus and its frame still when the session opens (phone) | Same 4 px frame shift on both |
| Logs: keeps the newest log reachable after refresh in webkit (390 px) | Same initial window: top 22468, height 89316, final visible row 000501, 16 reads |

Native inherited-failure admission preserves those red checks. The actual CI checkout `161cc04305b04cdc2195ee34cb511199521c2c55` has the ordered main/PR parents and their reconstructed merge tree; the six relevant failing-test/owner inputs are byte-identical to the recorded main parent. No additional suite rerun or passing-CI claim is made.
